result.title: KiteNorm: Variance Regularisation for Stable and Scalable Post-LN Transformers
result.summary: Post-LayerNorm Transformers have seen limited practical adoption due to enduring difficulties in scaling them to large depths. While prior research has focused on stabilising Post-LayerNorm by improving conditioning at initialisation, stability often deteriorates when models are trained with large learning rates, forcing additional compromises. In the decoder-only settings we study, existing Post-LayerNorm methods fail to outperform strong Pre-LayerNorm baselines. We propose KiteNorm, a post-norm training method designed to break this trend by constraining hidden-state variance. This approach is motivated by a bound on the LayerNorm Jacobian suggesting that variance growth contributes to gradient vanishing, alongside empirical evidence linking it to rank collapse. KiteNorm combines residual scaling and variance regularisation to maintain stability throughout training, supported by scalarised double-normalisation that provides separately learnable scales for the skip and residual branches. Across decoder-only Transformers up to 1.3B parameters, KiteNorm improves training stability and outperforms leading baselines at their optimal learning rates, with scaling laws favouring KiteNorm across depth, width, batch size, and training budget. Ablations show that each component is necessary for the full stability and performance gains.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对 Post-LayerNorm Transformer 难以扩展到深层的问题，提出 KiteNorm：结合残差缩放、隐状态方差正则化与双归一化可学习尺度，以抑制方差增长导致的梯度消失和秩坍缩，并在 1.3B 规模 decoder-only 模型上验证稳定性与扩展性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将隐状态方差增长与秩坍缩、表征区分度下降联系起来的做法，可供核查是否能用于缓解 LVR 多步潜在状态的信息坍缩与深层训练不稳；但论文未涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移仅为方法线索。
